(1) Yes, the image depicts a metallic lattice as a 2-D diagram, showing a regular arrangement of positive ions in a plane.
(2) Yes, delocalised electrons are shown as small blue circles with minus signs, free to move among the positive ions.
(3) Yes, there are labels: "POSITIVELY CHARGED METAL IONS", "ELECTRONS FROM OUTER SHELL OF METAL ATOMS", and "ELECTRONS ARE DELOCALIZED; THEY ARE FREE TO MOVE THROUGHOUT THE STRUCTURE".
